content:
As AirPods Pro 3 continue to enjoy a 25% discount and AirPods Max 2 drops by $100, weekend deals keep rolling in. Today's 9to5Toys "Lunch Break" headline is the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air on the market, returning to $1,099 (a $200 discount) in three colors at the official Apple Refurbished Store — this model usually sells out fast. We also have MacBook Neo with up to $120 off newer pricing, Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with Natural or Black Milanese Loop at nearly $100 off on Amazon, and the latest 240W braided Beats USB-C cable at an Amazon low of $18 with Prime shipping (40% off). Be sure to quickly check out the still-active 2026 Best Buy Back to School deals, and read on for more details.

Summer AirPods deals continue: Max 2 drops $100, AirPods Pro 3 25% off, starting at $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with Active Noise Cancellation) $149 (original price $179)
  • AirPods 4 (with Active Noise Cancellation) $119 (new original price $179) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy updates 2026 Back to School deals: TVs under $500, Bose discounts of $130, Apple products, Ninja kitchen appliances and more

Cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returns to $1,099 (a $200 discount) in three colors via the official Apple Refurbished Store

The official Apple Refurbished Store has always been a great place to save money, as retail prices for the current MacBook lineup have already been raised. However, stock for the Pro series and the cheapest M5 MacBook Air configuration fluctuates frequently — this morning we spotted the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air in three colors ready to go, priced at $1,099 — $200 off the original price.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,099 including shipping. This offer was still valid at the time of writing, available in Midnight, Starlight and Sky Blue models.

These products come with:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligibility to purchase AppleCare
  • Sold only after Apple's strict refurbishment process

What you're looking at is the cheapest configuration in the current M5 MacBook Air lineup, with the new unit priced at $1,299. Today, the Apple Refurbished Store offers $200 below the new unit price — the best deal we can find on the most affordable model in the current generation lineup.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (new unit original price $1,299)
  • Midnight, Starlight and Sky Blue

This is the Apple Refurbished Store, arguably the best quality refurbished MacBook Air on the market, but how does it compare to current retail new unit prices?

Amazon currently lists this configuration near its original price, with only the Silver model slightly lower at $1,240. Although this product has previously sold for less, since the price hike we haven't seen it sold on Amazon at a new unit price below $1,149, and even at that price, it was only a flash deal about a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with Natural or Black Milanese Loop drops by nearly $100 on Amazon

If I do say so myself, these two smartwatch combos are arguably the most beautiful in the world, and they're now nearly $100 off on Amazon — namely the Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the Natural Titanium or Black Titanium Milanese Loop.

Although the cheaper $100 discount on the Ocean Band version has disappeared, Amazon is currently selling the Natural or Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop for $799.99 including shipping.

These two configurations, featuring the gorgeous woven steel Milanese Loop, were originally priced at $899, but are now nearly $100 off with Amazon deals:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (original price $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (original price $899)

Apple is expected to launch the next-generation Ultra wearable next month, but as RAMageddon has already spread to the iPad and MacBook lineup, the new Apple Watch could become the next victim of price hikes. The existing product line hasn't been affected so far, but after all, they are all mini computers on the wrist, and the Ultra 4 or Series 12 could be the next victim at any time.

We certainly wouldn't blame anyone for wanting to wait until just before the September event to see what other tricks Apple has up its sleeve, but these products could become more expensive in less than a month.

The same situation may apply to Series models, which are also currently enjoying a $100 discount on Amazon:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

Grab the latest 240W braided Beats USB-C cable, down to an Amazon low of $18 with Prime shipping (40% off)

Hurry and grab the black 240W 10-foot Beats braided USB-C cable while it's still at the all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping.

Amazon is currently selling the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C braided cable for $18.03, with Prime members or orders over $35 qualifying for free shipping.

These new 2026 models offer higher power delivery specs, originally priced at $30, and frankly the pricing is a bit steep for a 10-foot high-end USB-C cable. But at 40% off the original price, I think everyone should have one or two of these high-quality, stylish cables for travel or at home.

Today's lowest-priced option is the Bolt Black model; other options include Navy at $19, Surge Stone dropping to $20.85 after applying the coupon on the deal page, and the red model is slightly under $24.

As mentioned above, this is the latest model, with power delivery significantly upgraded from the previous generation's 60W to 240W, and the cable length extended to 10 feet. It retains the same tangle-resistant braided design — "more durable, more convenient. Say goodbye to tangles, kinks and wear, for a fully upgraded charging experience."

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular model, $100 off, deals from $299

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand returns to Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

I tried and reviewed this product when it launched earlier this year, and Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a must-have for my everyday carry, travel bag and home charging. Now back on sale at nearly 35% off, it's the best time to grab one, matching Amazon's all-time low price.

The Anker Amazon official store is currently selling the latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 including shipping.

Originally priced at $150, this 3-in-1 charger features a MagSafe pad with up to 25W output, now at nearly 35% off, available in Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White.

This week's deals are similar to those previously mentioned, matching Anker's summer blowout and this year's Prime Day prices.

Although this charger is compact and portable, it has a solid heft that allows it to sit securely on a desk or nightstand, performing equally well for stationary desk use or on-the-go portability.

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Belkin's brand-new compact 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable for just $25
  • Charge all your desk devices for just $60 — SABRENT 252W 8-port charging station (all-time low)
  • Baseus 20,000mAh 100W laptop power bank with dual built-in cables for just $33 (58% off)
  • Acer braided USB/Thunderbolt 4 Type-C cable supports 240W charging and 8K video transmission for just $16
  • Anker 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display, today only $56
  • First deal: brand-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro lock with Ultra Wideband auto entry/exit functionality
  • KeySmart transparent "Ghost" SmartCard Find My wallet tracker returns to Amazon low
  • Spigen mini MagSafe iPhone pouch/EDC pocket bag for just $27
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter works in "over 200 countries worldwide" for just $20

Apple Refurbished Store MacBook Neo at lowest prices, up to $120 off original price

In addition to the MacBook Air and M5 MacBook Pro lineup, Apple's newly launched, more affordable MacBook Neo has also seen price hikes recently, but you can bypass the price hike through the Apple Certified Refurbished Store — MacBook Neo starts at $689 on Amazon, but you can buy it from the best Apple Refurbished Store with full Apple warranty, starting at $599.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers all MacBook Neo configurations at the lowest prices we can find from equally reputable sources, with full Apple warranty and Apple's "strict" refurbished quality certification.

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (new unit original price $699)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (new unit original price $799)

Although there doesn't seem to be any specific deal marking on the Apple Refurbished Store product pages, all models are at least $100 below the new unit's suggested retail price — the 512GB version with Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 lower than the new unit's original price, and $20 lower than its previous pricing.

Yes, they are refurbished units, and these prices only adjust back to (or very close to) the original suggested retail price, but don't forget we're talking about the lowest prices for the cheapest MacBook in the current generation lineup.

For some people, saving $100 to $120 isn't enough to offset concerns about buying refurbished, and that's understandable, but this is no small amount, and we're talking about the best quality refurbished products purchased directly from Apple.
